name: Taxila Museum
description: Taxila Museum is located at Taxila, Punjab Pakistan. The museum is home to a significant and comprehensive collection of Gandharan art dating from 2nd century BC to 7th century AD.
Most objects in the collection were excavated from the ruins of ancient Taxila.

name: Dharmarajika Stupa
description: The Dharmarajika Stupa is a large Buddhist stupa near Taxila, built to house relics of the Buddha and surrounded by a monastic complex.
The site was inscribed as part of the Taxila UNESCO World Heritage listing.

name: Julian
description: Julian is a ruined Buddhist monastery set on a hilltop east of Taxila, known for its stupa court and surviving stucco sculpture.
The remains include monastic cells, an assembly hall and a series of votive stupas.
